'''Christoph Jam''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] who was the owner and operator of [[Descorp]]. He maintained one of the largest [[Spy/Legends|spy]] networks on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], with a majority of the information focusing on criminals. He organized teams of [[Rectifier]]s whose purpose was to avenge attacks and injustices on law-abiding citizens of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].
